### Workflow handoff: urlshort-slice-delegated-b@1 step design_review

Workflow instance: 01M41HG4P6DEVAKTCJC6J9QAWP
Prior step: design (design) closed by design-agent@urlshort-factory
This step: design_review (design_review)
Objective: Independent review of design.md (and impact-analysis.md on brownfield slices) against the SPEC: every acceptance criterion reachable, error contract explicit, data model and migration reversible, threat model covering every new entry point, smallest structure that satisfies the SPEC. MUST-FIX or HIGH routes back to design; otherwise the locked set proceeds to plan_lock.

Prior step note: Design ready on SPEC e28cfea. Impact analysis aecb0d9 predates the design 5a6d168. V4 expand migration (verbatim in design-probe/migration/, assumed V4 after V3). link keeps created_at and gains updated_at (DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP only for v1-shaped inserts; the application stamps it on the service clock) and created_by/updated_by VARCHAR(64) 'anonymous'. audit_log gains created_at/updated_at (database clock) and created_by/updated_by defaulting to 'anonymous' = actor. Backfill: link COALESCE(retired_at, created_at); audit LEAST(occurred_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) with actors = actor. Writes: retire's conditional UPDATE stamps inline (same signature); a new LinkRepository.stamp(id, at) runs after the create's insert and after a key release, with the create's single now (AC-4). Link record, AuditLog, the responses and the shipped signatures (releaseIdempotencyKey(Long), retire(Long, Instant), the 6-arg Link) are unchanged, so the shipped tests stay unchanged (AC-9) and AC-8 holds by construction. LinkMigrationProbe K1-K5: schema; V3 upgrade keeps shipped values and constraints; backfill including a future occurred_at capped; v1 inserts filled on a connection kept open; stamp and retire statements; written rollback restores V3 exactly and V4 re-applies; 6.2 s for 100k links and 150k audit rows. AC-11's test runs the rollback lines read from the migration header. ADR-0020 amended. Re-check at plan-lock against merged main, including AuditTrail's named SELECT.
